comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
After completing the quest, you need to return to Europe and visit the Trainer NPC in one of the six player capital port cities. The Siamese Cat pet deed can be obtained from the Trainer.

Note: Trainers can only hold a single pet deed at a time. So if you do not pick up the pet deed, the quest (which is repeatable) will not reappear and even if someone pulls it for you, an additional deed cannot be won until you pick up the deed.

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: Hi, I would like to correct Guilder just a bit, the Trainer can only hold one pet deed at a time of "the same pet", in this case can only hold a single Siamese Cat, but can hold as many pets as there are quests for different ones. ;)
